name: ATM Deposited Media Item 1
definition: Information related to media item that are deposited.

MediaIdentification.name: Media Identification
MediaIdentification.definition: Within a list of MediaItems uniquely identifies a specific item. Typically will be an integer index 0..n, where there are n Items in the list of MediaItems.

UnitValue.name: Unit Value
UnitValue.definition: Amount or denomination of one media item, if the media type is valued or entered by the customer.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Currency of media items, if valued and different from base currency.

CodeLineFormat.name: Code Line Format
CodeLineFormat.definition: Format of the check code line.

ScannedValue.name: Scanned Value
ScannedValue.definition: Check amount scanned by the check reader.

ConfidenceLevel.name: Confidence Level
ConfidenceLevel.definition: Percentage of the confidence in the check amount.

RejectedReason.name: Rejected Reason
RejectedReason.definition: The reason a media item (such as a check) has been rejected. This may be used to inform the cardholder.

Reference.name: Reference
Reference.definition: String that uniquely identifies the media item in the FI's bank system. This may be used for traceability reasons.

AdditionalData.name: Additional Data
AdditionalData.definition: Key value pair which is associated with the media item. This provides flexibility to model some ad hoc data a FI wishes to pass through to the ATM.
